job.job_description:
Software Developer Full Stack | React, Node.js, .NET & Python


Job Summary

We are looking for a Software Developer with 45 years of hands-on experience in Full Stack Application Development, with strong exposure to React, Node.js, .NET/.NET Core and Python.

The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, integrating, testing and supporting secure, scalable and enterprise-grade applications. The role also requires practical experience with databases, REST APIs and modern AI-assisted software development tools to improve coding productivity, testing, debugging and application quality.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain scalable web and enterprise applications.
Develop backend applications and REST APIs using Node.js, .NET/.NET Core, ASP.NET and Python.
Develop responsive frontend applications using React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS.
Design and integrate REST APIs, Web Services and third-party APIs.
Work with databases such as MongoDB, Oracle, MS SQL Server and PostgreSQL.
Develop efficient SQL queries, stored procedures and database integration components.
Participate in application architecture, database design, code reviews and technical discussions.
Troubleshoot application, API, integration and database-related issues.
Follow secure coding, version control, testing and deployment best practices.
Collaborate with business users, functional teams and IT teams to understand requirements and deliver technical solutions.
Prepare and maintain technical and application documentation.

AI-Assisted Software Development

The candidate should have exposure to modern AI-assisted development tools and be able to leverage them for:

Code generation, optimization and refactoring
Debugging and troubleshooting
Code reviews
Unit test and test-case generation
API and technical documentation
SQL/query optimization
Rapid prototyping and PoCs
Understanding and modernizing legacy applications
Improving overall development productivity

Exposure to GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or equivalent AI coding assistants will be an advantage.

Basic understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, APIs and AI integration concepts is preferred.

Required Technical Skills

Backend

Node.js
.NET / .NET Core
ASP.NET
Python
REST API Development

Frontend

React
JavaScript / TypeScript
HTML5 / CSS

Databases

MongoDB
Oracle
MS SQL Server (MSSQL)
PostgreSQL

Integration & Tools

REST APIs, Web Services, JSON
Third-party API Integration
Git
Visual Studio / VS Code
CI/CD

Security

Application Security
Authentication & Authorization
API Security
Secure Coding Practices

Preferred / Good to Have

Microservices architecture using .NET, Node.js or Python
Docker / Kubernetes
CI/CD pipelines
Azure, AWS or GCP
Agile/Scrum methodology
Enterprise application development and integration
AI/ML or Generative AI application development

Candidate Profile

45 years of relevant software development experience
B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT or related discipline
Strong hands-on application development and debugging skills
Good understanding of SDLC and software engineering practices
Ability to independently understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Good communication and documentation skills
Willingness to learn and adopt AI-enabled development practices and emerging technologies
